opportunities.name: Hotel search, price conversion, and email proposal
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a hotel in a city for given dates, convert its price from EUR to a target currency on Xe, and draft an email to a colleague proposing the hotel.
steps: On Booking.com enter destination and select check-in/check-out dates (use Next month if needed)
Click Search and open a hotel from the results
Open Xe currency converter, type the hotel price into the EUR amount field
Set the target currency via the currency dropdown (search code, select option) if not USD
Click Convert and read the converted amount
Open mail New message, fill To, Subject 'Hotel for <city>, <dates>', Body with hotel name, EUR price and converted amount

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17-20, Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South, 818 EUR -> USD, maria@example.com
Milan, Dec 1-4, BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti, 264 EUR -> JPY, kenji@example.com
Amsterdam, Jan 12-15, Jan Luyken Amsterdam, 577 EUR -> GBP, aisha@example.com

opportunities.name: City weather and news heads-up email
opportunities.description: Look up a city's 10-day forecast on Weather.com, search the city plus 'strike' on BBC for the top story, and draft an email to a contact with weather and latest news.
steps: On weather site open location search, type city, select the match
On BBC open menu/search, type '<city> strike' and press Enter
Open the top article and note headline and date
Open mail New message, fill To, Subject 'Heads-up: <city> on <weekday>', Body with temps, conditions and headline

opportunities.name: Visa requirements and holidays note
opportunities.description: Look up a nationality's visa requirements on Wikipedia, look up the destination country's holidays on timeanddate, and save a summary note.
steps: On Wikipedia search 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens' and open the article
Find the destination country's visa entry and allowed stay
On timeanddate Holidays page open destination country holidays (dismiss privacy dialog if needed)
Note holidays in the relevant month
Add a note in Notes with traveler, visa status, allowed stay, holidays
